shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -80'
/bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!dist'"' && rg --files pages app src/pages src/app 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|next/router|next/head|next/document|NextApi|router|Head|Link|useRouter|useSearchParams|res\\.|req\\.\" . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg '(migrat|route-handlers|dynamic|not-found|error|metadata|layouts-and-pages|server-and-client|redirect|use-router)'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat AGENTS.md && for f in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' components/* styles/* next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo \"FILE "'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '"'^## |''^### |getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|_app|_document|_error|404|API Routes|useRouter|next/head|next/router|revalidate|dynamic'"' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/15-route-handlers.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/dynamic-routes.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/03-layouts-and-pages.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '123,225p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && sed -n '302,365p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md && sed -n '572,713p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md | head -180 && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/headers.md | head -120'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/06-fetching-data.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/10-error-handling.md'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n \"revalidate|cache: 'no-store'|force-cache|not cached by default\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/fetch.md | head -80 && rg -n 'metadata|title' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md | tail -15"
/bin/bash -lc 'curl -IL --max-time 8 https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=5'
/bin/bash -lc 'find pages -type f -o -type d && rg --files app components lib && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run start -- -p 3100'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
const base = 'http://localhost:3100'
const checks = [
  ['home', '/', { headers: { 'user-agent': 'MigrationCheck/1.0' } }, 200, 'MigrationCheck/1.0'],
  ['blog', '/blog', {}, 200, 'All Blog Posts'],
  ['generated post', '/blog/1', {}, 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['on-demand post', '/blog/11', {}, 200, 'Comments (5)'],
  ['missing post', '/blog/999', {}, 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
  ['unmatched route', '/missing-route', {}, 404, '404 - Page Not Found'],
  ['list API', '/api/posts', {}, 200, 'First Post'],
  ['create API', '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'New', content: 'Body' }) }, 201, 'New'],
  ['invalid create', '/api/posts', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' }, 400, 'Title and content are required'],
  ['single API', '/api/posts/4', {}, 200, 'Post 4'],
  ['update API', '/api/posts/4', { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ title: 'Updated' }) }, 200, 'Updated'],
  ['delete API', '/api/posts/4', { method: 'DELETE' }, 200, 'deleted successfully'],
  ['unsupported method', '/api/posts', { method: 'PATCH' }, 405, ''],
]
let failures = 0
for (const [label, path, options, status, content] of checks) {
  const response = await fetch(base + path, options)
  const body = await response.text()
  const ok = response.status === status && body.includes(content)
  console.log("'`${ok ? '"'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "'${label}: ${response.status}`)
  if (!ok) failures++
}
process.exitCode = failures ? 1 : 0
NODE'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css && rg -n "next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse" app components lib || true && test ! -e pages && echo '"'pages removed'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start -- -p 3100'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
const cases = [
  ['/api/posts', 'PATCH', 405, 'GET, POST'],
  ['/api/posts', 'OPTIONS', 405, 'GET, POST'],
  ['/api/posts', 'HEAD', 405, 'GET, POST'],
  ['/api/posts/4', 'POST', 405, 'GET, PUT, DELETE'],
  ['/api/posts/4', 'OPTIONS', 405, 'GET, PUT, DELETE'],
]
for (const [path, method, status, allow] of cases) {
  const response = await fetch("'`http://localhost:3100${path}`, { method })
  const ok = response.status === status && response.headers.get('"'allow') === allow
  console.log("'`${ok ? '"'PASS' : 'FAIL'} "'${method} ${path}: ${response.status}, Allow=${response.headers.get('"'allow')}"'`)
  if (!ok) process.exitCode = 1
}
NODE'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && test ! -e pages && echo '"'pages directory absent' && rg --files app components lib && git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && cat next-env.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json'
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 2 -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -o -name '.next' && du -sh .next"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && test ! -e pages && echo '"'Pages Router directory removed' && rg -n \"next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps\" app components lib || true"
